data.gender_notes: Ayaneh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ayaneh is derived from the Persian word 'ayyaneh' which means 'moonlight'. This name is often given to girls in the Islamic world as a symbol of the divine light that guides them through life. The name Ayaneh carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayaneh usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
